name: profile-settings
title: Profile settings
description: A settings page for the signed-in person: photo, name, a username checked as you type and a bio behind one save bar, then emails, passkeys and connected accounts.

useCases: Apps with social and passkey sign-in

a11y.reducedMotion: Nothing slides, grows or shakes: the save bar, the opening lists and the email edits only fade, rows below take their new place at once, and the spinners hold still.

keyboard.action: Moves through the nav, each field, the email pens, the sign-in buttons and, when it shows, the save bar
Saves the profile while there are unsaved changes
In a field, leaves it; pressed again, discards the unsaved changes. While an email is being changed, cancels that change
Opens the passkeys list, More sign-in options or an account's ⋯ menu

notes: Every field has a visible label; descriptions and hints are linked with `aria-describedby`, and the username's availability is announced in a polite live region.
The save bar is a region named “Unsaved changes”. Its message (“2 unsaved changes”, “Changes saved”) is a polite live region, and a changed row adds “(changed)” to its label for screen readers.
Icon-only buttons are named for what they do: “Change photo”, “Change primary email”, “More actions for Google”. The provider logos are hidden from screen readers.
The passkeys count and More sign-in options are buttons with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; the current nav link has `aria-current="page"`.
Leaving with unsaved changes keeps you on the page and says “Save or discard your changes first”; closing the tab asks the browser to confirm.
gaps: Disconnecting an account or removing the secondary email happens at once, with no confirmation or undo. (WCAG 3.3.4 Error Prevention)
